author_inference_review: Passed 160 states, 4 resets, 24 endpoint clamps and shuffled joint order; all observed inputs, outputs and motor targets exactly equal to original inference under the same sampled initial_noise and nominal sensor state. 126 cases exercised native target limits.

checkpoint_origin.verification: All three original ONNX files match pinned Git blob SHA1 and local SHA256; no conversion.

deployment.history: 15x90 oldest-first zero initial history; base history uses previous base action; residual input uses previous combined action.
deployment.reference: Next control frame, t+0.02 s; final canonical frame clamped. Reference frame zero initializes heading registration.
deployment.architecture: Original flow base + residual (gain1, no tanh) + original FK; float32 CPU ONNX, named joint mapping and native torque-speed envelope target clipping.
deployment.randomness: Per-clip Core seed initializes a dedicated CPU torch.Generator. Standard-normal initial_noise retained. Random warm-up and unused zero-amplitude sensor random draws are not replayed. Conditional native parity uses identical noise. No deterministic zero-noise replacement.
deployment.sensor_noise: Nominal protocol requires no sensor noise; author config base_ang_vel noise0.1 is disabled explicitly.
deployment.physics: Author pd_control_friction, simulator XML, initial height0.79 and action delay belong to the author simulator, not the learned policy. They do not override common Core initialization, dynamics, friction, motor limits or failure/scoring rules.
deployment.target_filter: Native target envelope is computed at the control tick and retained; normal PD torque computation at physics ticks remains in Core.
